transactions.property_name: Slovakia portfolio (5 logistics/light-industrial property companies: Kosice Industrial Park, Nove Mesto ONE Industrial Park I/II/III, Zilina Industrial Park)
transactions.citation: Line 1793-1795 (Manager's report): completed 11 Nov 2025 via sale of 100% of shares in the 5 Slovakian property companies for EUR70.0 million, 'representing EUR2.3 million or 3.5% premium to the net asset value of EUR67.7 million as at 30 June 2025, based on independent valuation conducted by Savills.' Corroborated at line 7968 (FS Note) and line 1836 (footnote 9): 'The valuation of the Slovakia portfolio was EUR72.4 million as at 30 June 2025. The total property price agreed was EUR71.4 million. The final consideration received was EUR70.0 million - a EUR2.3 million or 3.5% premium to the net equity value of EUR67.7 million for the five companies as at 30 June 2025.'
transactions.notes: ONE deal, ONE deal_id for all 5 properties -- confirmed the AR discloses ONLY a portfolio-level total for Slovakia throughout (Manager's report, FS Note 5(a) p201, and the country-level property tables all show a single combined Slovakia figure, e.g. 'Slovakia | 71,410 | - | 71,410' at line 7342); no per-property price or valuation breakdown exists anywhere in the AR. Share sale of subsidiaries (entity-level), so reference_basis is net_identifiable_assets (net equity/NAV of the 5 SPVs, EUR67.7m), NOT 'valuation' -- correcting an earlier internal draft that had mislabeled this as vs_valuation. Note the DISTINCT independent property valuation of EUR72.4m (30 Jun 2025, Savills) is a separate reference point (consideration EUR70.0m is actually a 3.3% DISCOUNT to that EUR72.4m valuation) but is NOT the basis the AR's disclosed 3.5% premium is computed against -- the disclosed premium is explicitly tied to net asset value/net equity value of the companies (EUR67.7m), so that is the basis recorded here, per spec Rule 5 (do not substitute a different reference to make the story cleaner). Accounting gain on disposal of subsidiaries EUR1,181k per Note 5(a) (p201). Total consideration for all Slovakia+Italy+Poland divestments combined was 'EUR139.6 million ... an 11% premium to net valuations' (portfolio-level, line 1789/1546); that 11% figure is a BLENDED figure across all 5 divestment deals in this file (Slovakia + 4 office properties) and is NOT applied to this row.

transactions.citation: Manager's report p42: consideration EUR15.0m, 0.7% below the 30 Jun 2024 independent valuation (EUR15.1m, Savills). Divestments Completed in FY2025 table p43: purchaser Agenzia del Demanio, valuation EUR15.1m.
transactions.notes: Per-property accounting gain/loss NOT disclosed separately -- folded into a combined office-property divestment loss of EUR1,943k (Note 5(b), p202) covering this property, Arkonska Business Park and Cassiopea 1-2-3 together. 31 Dec 2024 carrying value (fair-value model) EUR15,000k per Note 17 asset-held-for-sale, 2024 column (p240) -- this carrying figure was itself remeasured to the contracted price, so a vs_book_value derivation from it would be circular/near-zero and is not used as the primary figure; the disclosed vs_valuation figure (-0.7%) is used instead.

transactions.property_name: AiOnX data centre development fund (investment in financial asset, via Business Trust)
transactions.counterparty: AiOnX data centre fund (managed by a controlling shareholder of the Business Trust Trustee-Manager)
transactions.citation: Note 10, p214: 'On 23 June 2025, Stoneweg European BT Group ... invested EUR50.0 million in the Stoneweg Iona data-centre fund (subsequently rebranded to AiOnX).'
transactions.notes: EUR50m subscription in a fund managed by a controlling shareholder of the BT Trustee-Manager (related-party angle, flagged for reference); carried at fair value EUR70,536k at 31 Dec 2025, a EUR20,536k fair-value uplift (Note 10 / Statement of Cash Flows p171). This is a subscription/acquisition, not a divestment -- the FV uplift is an unrealised revaluation, not a realised transaction gain, so gain_loss_pct is not populated. SERT's effective stake in the fund is approximately 6.6%; equity/fair-value accounted, not consolidated into the Portfolio Statement.
